content.short: Interface provides a human readable social Web3 feed.
content.description: Interface is a social mobile app that delivers a human-readable Web3 feed designed to make complex Web3 content approachable. For everyday users, it offers a friendly space to browse, participate, interact, and stay informed about evolving Web3 protocols, projects, communities, and assets, all in one accessible stream. For developers, Interface provides a platform to bootstrap decentralized applications, enhance readability and discoverability in their products, and contribute to open-source, collaborative public-good repositories like the decoder (also known as MARI) within the coding community.
content.meta: Interface is a social mobile app with a human readable Web3 feed. Discover Interface and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
